# dreamlab

> dreamlab is a creative technology studio exploring what's possible at the edge of AI, real-time computing, and immersive experience. We co-create next-generation content, workflows, products, and worlds across film, content, games, advertising, music, and art — working with brands, studios, and IP to turn emerging technology into impact driven creative output.

Based across Manchester, Liverpool, Cumbria and London. 48+ deep tech specialists working from labs at MediaCity Manchester, Liverpool, the Lake District (Cumbria) and London.

## Locations

- MediaCity, Manchester — primary lab
- Liverpool
- Cumbria (Lake District) — residential co-creation facility
- London

## Our expertise & capabilities

### Workflows & Automation
From proprietary studio tooling and infrastructure to multi-agent AI systems and generative content pipelines for video, image and audio — we design and build the automation and workflows that amplify your team and scale your capabilities. We create the IP and systems that give your studio an unfair advantage.
- Proprietary Studio Tooling & IP: Custom-built tools and systems that become your studio's competitive advantage
- Studio Infrastructure & Scaling: The architecture and automation that scales your team's output and capabilities
- Creative AI Workflows: Generative video, image and audio pipelines for production teams
- AI Agent Development: Custom LLM-powered agents for complex, multi-step tasks
- Agentic AI Systems: Autonomous AI pipelines for research, analysis and action
- RAG Systems: Retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise knowledge
- LLM Integration: Embed AI into existing tools and platforms seamlessly
- Process Automation: End-to-end pipeline automation and workflow redesign
- Intelligent Document Processing: Extract, classify and act on unstructured data at scale

### Creative Services
We put technology in service of extraordinary people and ideas. Our creative services amplify what your studio and your talent can achieve — immersive experiences, XR environments, virtual productions, interactive installations and generative content that moves people — whether in a gallery, a game, a broadcast or a brand activation.
- AI Native & Technology Enhanced Creative Campaigns: Using the power of AI to create impact for your brand
- Creative AI Workflows: Generative video, image and audio pipelines for production teams
- Generative Content & AI Art: Creative AI tools for image, video, sound and text
- Immersive XR Experiences: VR, AR and MR design and production
- Virtual Production: Unreal Engine LED volume and real-time filmmaking
- Interactive Installations: Sensor-driven, projection mapped and generative art
- AI-Assisted Animation: Real-time characters, procedural animation, motion AI
- Game Development: Concept to launch across platforms and engines
- Projection Mapping: Large-scale architectural and experiential projection
- Spatial Audio & Sound Design: Immersive audio, AI music tools and interactive sound

### Product Development
We partner with founders, studios and enterprises to build tech products that set new standards. From early-stage prototyping and technical validation to full production engineering, we bring deep expertise in AI, spatial computing, realtime systems and software architecture to every build. We specialise in AI native products — harnessing personalisation, contextualisation and participation to create experiences that respond, adapt and connect. Whether it's interactive, physical or social, we make bold ideas go wild.
- AI Product Development: Custom AI applications from concept to production
- Spatial Computing: AR glasses, mixed reality and spatial interfaces
- Software Architecture: Scalable systems design and technical strategy
- Realtime Systems: High-performance engines, WebGL, Unreal, Unity
- Prototype & MVP Development: Rapid, validated builds to test ideas quickly
- Digital Twin Development: Real-time digital replicas of physical systems
- Decentralised Technology: Bitcoin, Lightning Network, Nostr and Web3 protocols
- Open Hardware & IoT: Sensor integration, physical computing and device design

### Consultancy & Training
Want to build these capabilities yourself? Our training and consultancy programmes give studios and teams the hands-on skills to harness AI, immersive technology and creative workflows — through residential programmes, masterclasses, bespoke workshops and embedded advisory. Learn the tools, techniques and strategic thinking to drive transformation from within your own team.
- Enterprise AI Programmes: Residential deep tech training for enterprise and SME teams
- AI Commander Masterclass: 5-day intensive curriculum for AI leadership and strategy
- Co-Creation Residencies: Embedded R&D sprints at our Lake District facility
- Bespoke Workshops: Tailored in-person and online workshops for any team
- AI Strategy Consultancy: Expert advisory on AI adoption, risk and opportunity
- Immersive Tech Training: XR, virtual production, Unreal Engine and spatial computing
- Innovation Programme Design: Build internal innovation capability and culture
- Media Production Training: Avid certified post-production and broadcast workflow training

## Sectors we work across

- Games: Interactive entertainment, indie development, game engines, esports technology and gaming innovation.
- Film & TV: Virtual production, immersive storytelling, visual effects pipelines and broadcast technology.
- Music: Interactive audio, AI music tools, immersive sound design and music technology innovation.
- Animation: Real-time animation, AI-assisted production, procedural content and digital characters.
- Health: VR therapeutics, medical visualisation, patient education and AI-powered health tools.
- Education: Immersive learning experiences, AI tutoring, skills training platforms and EdTech innovation.
- Marketing & Advertising: Creative AI campaigns, interactive brand experiences, generative content and experiential marketing.
- Creator Economy: Tools and platforms empowering independent creators with AI, interactivity and emerging technology.
- Performance & Live: Real-time visuals, interactive installations, live event technology and performative tech.

## The team

The dreamlab collective is 48 specialists. Selected members:

- **Dr John O'Hare** — Founder & Chief Hallucination Officer (HP AI Lighthouse Partner): Dr John O'Hare is the Founder of dreamlab AI and an HP AI Lighthouse Partner. Over 25 years at the intersection of tech and creativity, he leads pioneering work in AI-driven workflows, multi-agent orchestration and creative technology. As CTO of the company behind Unreal Engine's flagship third-party plugins, he shipped tools used by AAA game studios and Hollywood productions. From AI systems for autonomous marine vessels to immersive media at scale, he helps organisations understand what's actually possible with AI agents — and keep humans in the loop where it matters.
- **Ste Moyler** — Chief Creative Officer (Ex-McCann Worldgroup): Ste is an award-winning creative director and producer with 25+ years in film, animation, AR/VR and immersive media. He has delivered projects for Microsoft, Sony Music and Adidas, and led MediaCityUK's first docuseries. Ste is known for mentoring creative talent and driving innovation in digital storytelling — ensuring the technology we build always serves a bigger idea.
- **Pete Woodbridge** — Founder & Chief Technical Officer (BIMA 100 · 2020): Pete is a founder of dreamlab and its Chief Technical Officer — a creative technologist and virtual production specialist working at the intersection of AI, immersive storytelling, interactive experiences and virtual production. Named in the BIMA 100 'Creatives & Designers' in 2020, his career spans commissions and R&D collaboration with BBC, ITV, Aardman Animations, Google, Intel, Apple, BT, the United Nations, Red Bull and the NHS. He also serves as R&D Innovation Lead at MediaFutures and publishes the Dream Machine newsletter — essential reading on creative AI.
- **Jing Li** — Creative AI · Eurasia Pacific: Jing is a Creative AI developer and technologist with a background spanning business, technology and community innovation. After a decade in sustainable fashion, she retrained into data science and applied AI — now building and deploying generative tools for SMEs and creative practitioners at dreamlab, and connecting the collective to partners across the Eurasia Pacific region. Dedicated to responsible innovation, AI equity and making emerging technologies accessible to communities that are usually last in line.
- **Dr Derek Hales** — Cyberphysical Pataphysicist (UKRI Innovate UK Funded): Derek is an architect and R&D director with 30+ years in speculative practices, XR and digital twinning. With a PhD in Design Fiction, he leads research and innovation across architecture, film and immersive media, shaping creative-technology policy and open innovation. A Research Fellow at The New Centre for Research & Practice and Lecturer at the University of Salford, his practice has been funded by Arts Council England, AHRC, EPSRC, UKRI Innovate UK and the EU Framework Programme.
- **Arpana Nandakumar** — Alternate Realities Sorceress & Public Engagement: Arpana is an XR and AI specialist with expertise in real-time technical art, advanced haptics and immersive media. Working with partners including the University of Salford, she leads public engagement initiatives and is recognised for her work in gender equality and mixed-reality innovation.
- **Bernard Steer** — Spatial Audio Consultant (Avid ACI Certified Trainer): Bernard is a spatial audio consultant and Avid ACI-certified Pro Tools trainer with 20+ years in creative technology. He founded compact Dolby Atmos / DTS-X monitoring solutions used across UK post-production, and leads spatial-audio consultancy for immersive-tech residencies at MediaCity's dreamlab. Bernard has worked with broadcasters, post houses and music studios bridging Avid, Dolby and Pro Tools ecosystems.

## Frequently asked questions

### What size of projects do you work on?
We work with organisations of all sizes — from early-stage startups building their first AI product to large enterprises running innovation programmes. Our work ranges from short advisory engagements to multi-month co-creation residencies.

### Do you work outside of Manchester?
Yes — while we're rooted in the North West UK, we work with organisations nationally and internationally. Our Lake District facility is available for residential residencies, and we can embed with your team wherever you're based.

### What's a co-creation residency?
A co-creation residency is an intensive R&D sprint where your team comes to our Lake District innovation facility — or we embed with you — to rapidly develop, prototype and validate a product or technology idea. They typically run 3–5 days and are designed to unlock breakthroughs that would take weeks in a normal working environment.

### How quickly can you respond to an enquiry?
We aim to respond to all enquiries within one working day. For urgent projects, reach out directly via email and flag it as time-sensitive.

### Can you help if we're not sure what we need?
Absolutely. Some of our best projects started with "we know we need to do something with AI but we're not sure what." We're happy to start with a discovery conversation and help shape the right approach before any commitment is made.
